rendering.shadow_policy: Unity Shadow only. No shadow baked into exported PNG/SVG. useGraphicAlpha=true. No second shadow sprite.
rendering.sort: external scene -> counter -> keeper -> Shop_BG -> panels/shadows -> watermarks -> goods -> prices/icons -> TMP -> runtime HUD/QuestTracker

notes: Only new UI geometry included. Existing icons, sold-out masks, watermarks are external v2 references.
All shop labels and prices are TMP; game card prefab contents are unchanged external runtime visuals.
PriceTag uses real 9-slice; keep 24 source-pixel borders at 2x, 12 logical pixels.
Credit value 33 makes all displayed goods and service unaffordable. Source component default is Color.red; serialized game override remains authoritative.
Mockup uses source screenshot card captures, so their sharpness is limited by supplied screenshot resolution.
No scene, prefab, importer, or .meta file edits.
